owner: Item-scope steps now send `item_ids` for every line, not only minutes (F-17 `accept_answer`, F-21/F-22 item steps). The contract allows it and the checks pass, but the backend handler for each line must accept or ignore it.

`minutesProposalsStripped` strips `links` and `items_default` from every E-WORK-ITEM fixture, not only W-23xx. The "exist on their own" test limits where the keys occur and checks that they live only in W-23xx, which is acceptable. A malformed `items_default` in an older fixture would still be caught by `toBe('checked')`.

The phone boards were not re-scored after the F-24 phone-bar change (the builder says so). Desktop default visual 69.7 is under the D-83 floor and needs the design engineer. This is the UI and fidelity lane, not technical.

The Actions table keeps its 560px width inside a scroll region, so Due, Edit and Remove sit off screen (Remove starts at x=492 of 390). The region is focusable and labelled, so it is reachable, but the PM has to scroll sideways to edit or remove, and the board draws "owner · due" rows.

Decisions sit in the right column with the tick above the text and a full-width Edit button, so the page reads Actions first, Decisions second. The board has decisions first, a tick beside the text and a link Edit. This is exception 6 (frame layout), which D-98 did not list as signed.
After "+ Add an action" the page says "Done: + Add an action." with the plus sign in it, and a blank add says "Add action to continue."
Tola's panel says "step 1 of 1" and "Reading the meeting notes", while the board and the checklist say "step 3 of 4".

Flagged lines always draw after the plain lines, in a second callout, whatever their index. A `warn_lines` entry of 0 or 1 would reorder the sentences. The agent name is also not repeated if all lines are flagged. Current fixtures use index 2 (the last line), so there is no visible issue.

`GET /projects/P-0101/money` is asserted to be 501 through the full mock server. F-26 routes money to `money.mjs` before the M1 check (its server.mjs line ahead of `if (!M1_OPERATIONS...)`), so this assertion fails after the second merge.

`ProjectView` and `ProjectPage` gain a `caseId` prop. The spec says "one import and one branch, nothing else changes", and `journey.case_id` is already available (F-26 uses it for `MoneyTab`). On a tab 403/404 the `PmRoute` line ("PM <name> · Route ...") still draws above the panel that says "Nothing from it is shown here". An invoice whose `state` is absent or not in `STATE_TAGS` shows only its reference. That reads as "no status" and not as Unknown. It is a fact the data could not supply, so the amber Unknown the spec uses elsewhere would be more honest.

Milestone cells other than CONTRACT AMOUNT are now one line with an ellipsis. A long completion text, invoice word or change title is cut on screen, so the full fact is no longer visible. The text stays in the DOM and is read by screen readers, but a sighted user cannot read it. This trades fidelity for completeness.

`TabEmpty` hard-codes the `psl-empty` markup and an `h3` in place of the shared `EmptyState`. This avoids the repeated sentence the UX review asked to remove. It copies the shared component's markup, and the page's heading levels for the empty state are unchecked.

`project-tabs.css` has `.ptabs__ms td:not(:nth-child(2)) { white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; }`. With the fixed percentage widths, this visually cuts amounts, owed figures, invoice states and proof text whenever the table is narrower than the board. A cut-off money or completion fact breaks the "facts shown separately, never hidden" rule (INV-FACTS) and the readability bar. The P-0102 edge rows (non-NGN amounts, several changes) are longer still.

The round-2 board render of `SCR-11-desktop.dc.html` differs from round 1 (board.png md5 4a0857ce… vs ab554d12…), with the h1 and wordmark in a fallback font. The other 7 board renders are byte-identical across rounds. The `visual_waivers` reasons in `fidelity-exceptions.json` are now out of date. For example, SCR-38-desktop still says "the table column widths follow the page's own table", which is no longer true.
`.ptabs__route { line-height: 18px; }` is a literal pixel value. It passes AC 22, which only greps for colours, but it is the only non-token size in the file.

owner: Commit 93dc1e56 changed `.ptabs__card { line-height: 1.3 }` to `line-height: var(--text-hint-line)` (`frontend/src/features/projects/project-tabs.css:31`). An absolute 18 px line height now applies to every line in a card, including the 12px invoice/paid/reference lines (15.6 px tall before, now 18 px) and the 13px main lines (16.9 px, now 18 px). The boards draw these cards at the font's normal line height. Each milestone card grows by about 5–6 px (about 23 px over the four cards), and register cards by about 3 px. So the phone cards move away from the board, and the signed SCR-38-mobile waiver's sentence "Card text sizes and spacing match the board" is no longer true. All four phone waivers (D-110: 76.7, 80.8, 77.6, 84.3) were measured on the 1.3 cards, not on this head.

Closing an issue needs QA and the PM; there is no separate approval." and SCR-38 "Milestones and amounts come from the signed SOW. Completing a milestone is the PM's fact; invoicing and payment are Finance's, and each is shown separately."; (g) the G-SCR11-2 ask to design for the other registers' columns; (h) the mock limits: D-PROJECT-TAB-ROWS is `proposed`, the backend may change or refuse any field, E-PROJECT-TAB has no backend, and the Documents tab row shape is still an engineering proposal; (i) the frontend labels "Paid", "Part paid", "Not paid", "Not due" and "Tracked by Finance" for the `paid.status` enum.
